hypothesis: With two encoder calls per invocation and fixed model dimensions, instruction count is primarily explained by per-prompt overhead, padded token volume, batched attention size, and shared relative-position work.

pcvs.name: batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-prompt cleaning, tokenization, slicing, and padding overhead.

pcvs.expression: (1 if isinstance(prompt, str) else len(prompt)) * max_sequence_length
pcvs.name: padded_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Models encoder projections, feed-forward computation, and embedding copies.

pcvs.expression: (1 if isinstance(prompt, str) else len(prompt)) * max_sequence_length ** 2
pcvs.name: attention_elements
pcvs.rationale: Models quadratic attention computation across the batch.

pcvs.name: position_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Captures relative-position bias construction shared across batch elements.
